betweenAttempts.learned: First attempt showed a coil/cover marker could produce COVER and spend rounds. Second attempt approached to HOLD FACE COILS before choosing visible coil heads. Retained tap-aim and route/approach assistance learned from visible prompts.
betweenAttempts.inferenceLimit: Different mission times/accuracy are observed results only; not evidence of a causal quality benefit or human learning/reaction-time improvement under frequent pauses.

assessment.scale: 0 unusable, 5 functional with substantial friction, 7 good with noticeable limitations, 9 excellent across assessed use, 10 exceptional. Scores are subjective observed mobile-emulation quality, not a mission-outcome grade or physical-device certification.

reasons.overallMOBILE: Coherent short mission with workable two-contact combat and useful navigation aids. Target readability and target-versus-cover ambiguity reduce confidence; continuous handheld comfort is unassessed. Both wins alone do not set this grade.
reasons.controls: MOVE plus FIRE drag produced visible guard/patrol kills in both attempts; scene swipe and threat turn worked. Tap aims and assisted shots contributed, preventing claims of unaided precision. Capture releases preclude held-burst rearming assessment.
reasons.gameplay: Three recoveries, per-coil progress, and deck hold create understandable stage changes. The brief sampled combat is readable through feedback, but assisted travel dominates and long-term tension/enjoyment cannot be assessed.
reasons.presentation: Rain, dark cyan/gold palette, industrial silhouettes, rifle feedback, and consistent title/result typography form a cohesive atmosphere. Audio was not assessed.
reasons.usability: Large persistent action controls, route/approach prompts, explicit map close, fresh restart and terminal stats help orientation. HOLD FACE COILS and cover-marker targeting needed interpretation.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo, objectives and coil OFF states are clear. Distant targets, map legend, compact HUD copy and dark busy geometry make fine distinctions harder at 390px width.

uncertainties: Shot-level misses and assistance contribution not independently audited; game accuracy reported verbatim.
No audio, Safari, physical phones, hardware performance, continuous handheld comfort or continuous enjoyment assessment.
